description: The first step of launching: { id, message, expiresAt } for your Solana wallet. Sign message (its UTF-8 bytes) with the wallet's ed25519 key and give id and the signature (base64) to sign_in within 5 minutes. Signing it authorizes no transaction or transfer. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

wallet.description: Your Solana wallet's address (base58): the wallet that will launch, pay and sign.
